text:
alana: Heads up — RFC for adding event_kind (string) + dedup_key to telemetry rows. Biggest goal: make console rollups cheaper and avoid duplicate ingestion from retries. quick brain dump below.

deepak: short Q — why a new column instead of reusing event_type?

alana: event_type is enum of product-level things. event_kind would be the backend classification used for indexing and quotas (e.g., user_action, system_metric, billing_event). keeps product schema stable.

mia: will this change affect existing dashboards?
\alana: read paths stay backwards compatible. plan is shadow-write event_kind for 2 weeks, then backfill for last 30d into analytic shards, then flip index. dashboards should point to event_kind after flip.

len: backfill strategy? full table rewrite will spike IO. any incremental approach?
\alana: proposal: lockless shadow backfill + TTLed shadow column during transition. steps: 1) add nullable event_kind and dedup_key cols 2) start writing event_kind and dedup_key for all new events 3) run streaming backfill job that updates rows using PK ranges and idempotent upserts 4) when coverage > 99.5% swap plans (index + query layer).

ravi: what about dedup_key collisions and routing? some producers already generate idempotency_key. we need mapping rules.
\deepak: we should accept both: if producer sends idempotency_key use that, else synthesize dedup_key = sha256(route||timestamp||event_hash). include producer-version in metadata to avoid accidental cross-producer reuse.

mia: console UX — rollout flags for customers to preview. we need API version header handling so old clients keep using event_type.
\alana: yep. Add x-redwood-api-shape: v2-preview to surface event_kind. default stays v1. Also add console toggle: use_event_kind_index (org-level).

len: index plan? composite index on (org_id, event_kind, ingestion_day) plus dedup_key unique constraint scoped to org_id + event_kind?
\deepak: unique constraints are expensive. prefer de-dup in streaming consumer and a sparse unique index only on recent days. For long tail rely on dedup_job.

ops-bot: deploy job scheduled: telemetry-shadow-write v1 -> canary 10% at 2026-03-30T22:00Z, full rollout 2026-04-06T03:00Z.

ravi: monitoring — we need metrics: shadow_coverage_pct, backfill_rate_rows_per_sec, dedup_conflicts_per_min. also trace per-tenant backfill ETA.
\alana: agreed. also create alert if shadow_coverage stops increasing for >2h.

mia: one more compliance note: if dedup_key stores any PII we must hash with per-org salt (kms). update data retention policy.
\alana: technical checklist I'm going to track: 
- schema migration SQL (nullable cols)
- shadow write lib changes (sdk + ingestion lambda)
- streaming backfill job (idempotent)
- index build plan (staged)
- API header + console toggle
- observability dashboards + alerts
- rollout runbook + rollback steps
\deepak: i'll take schema SQL and index plan. len you own backfill job. mia handle UI toggle + API header. ravi owners observability. i'll pair on migrations with len.

alana: sweet. if nobody objects i'll open PRs and a runbook doc. objections?

len: NACK until we have perf estimate for index builds. need rough IO and mem numbers.

alana: fair. i'll add perf foils and expected index build windows into PR.

ops-bot: NOTE: thread archived after 30 days of inactivity.
